key_catalyst: US-Iran diplomacy collapses as Rubio says Iran 'not serious about talks,' strikes enter 12th day, Brent surges above $92-93 and 10-year yield hits 4.62% two-month high
reasoning: The US-Iran conflict is escalating into its 12th day with diplomacy now explicitly stalled (Rubio: Iran 'not serious about talks'), pushing Brent above $92-93 and 10-year yields to 4.62-4.63% — exceeding the 4.60% level that coincided with QQQ's -1.64% drop on July 16. The July 21 rally (+1.85%) was specifically driven by a 6bps yield drop to 4.36%, which has now fully reversed, and the chip-stock rebound that powered that rally is unwinding in pre-market. With Alphabet and Tesla earnings after the close adding uncertainty, the pre-market -0.66% appears to underprice the severity of the re-escalation.
